evidence: CDIAL 13271 sarpa explicitly gives Assamese xāp and Bengali sāp snake. Hajong hap shares the corresponding p-final stem.
CDIAL 13544.1 sūkara explicitly gives Bengali suor, Gujarati suvar and regional sūr/sōr pig. Hajong huvar/huvur/hur/hor fit these first-branch outcomes.
CDIAL 13561 sūtra explicitly gives Assamese xutā and Bengali/Oriya sutā thread. Hajong huta/hutu fit this thread stem.

CDIAL 12548 śuṣka explicitly gives Prakrit sukka and regional sukā/suko dry, with Assamese xukān in an extended form. Simple Hajong huka fits the unextended stem; hukna/huknu/hukase are not assigned by this rule.
